_doc: The GUI consoles' command table, read by the browser (js/console/shell/table.js) and the desktop (support/console/consoleGrammar.cpp): one row per command with its aliases, argument hint, help line, help section and the surfaces it exists on; a `cliMode` row answers only inside the secret CLI mode. The Zig CLI's own console keeps its list in cli/src/console/uiText.txt. `cliMode` names the typed word that opens the secret CLI mode in both apps, the ms a press on its logo takes to leave it, and the command that leaves it. Each surface's test proves every one of its rows has a handler and every handler a row.

commands.name: upload
commands.help: load a picture or video frame; bare: pick a file (browser: the file dialog; desktop: the Open Image window)

commands.name: open
commands.help: open a saved project by name or id, a picture by URL or a launch link; the desktop app takes a local image, layout or .stencil path too

commands.name: blank
commands.help: create a blank page (default: the picked format or A4, white)

commands.name: format
commands.help: list the page formats or pick one (drives /blank + the layout)

commands.name: apply
commands.help: draw a layout JSON onto the image, from a URL or pasted inline

commands.name: rotate
commands.help: rotate int*90 degrees (e.g. -1, 2, 3)

commands.name: flip
commands.help: mirror the image left-right (crop and lines follow)

commands.name: filter
commands.help: bw | sepia | invert | contour | none | a colour name/#hex (tint)

commands.name: script
commands.help: run .stc directives on this project (';' separates statements)

commands.name: undo
commands.help: step back through edits

commands.name: redo
commands.help: step forward through edits

commands.name: reset
commands.help: undo every edit back to the original

commands.name: color
commands.help: the line colour new lines are drawn in

commands.name: point-color
commands.help: the point colour (clear: follow the line colour)

commands.name: project-color
commands.help: show or set the project's name colour

commands.name: save
commands.help: save the project (a .stencil path writes the project file; another path the picture)

commands.name: layout
commands.help: save the layout JSON

commands.name: connect
commands.help: connect to a collaboration server

commands.name: disconnect
commands.help: close a connection (or the most recent)

commands.name: connections
commands.help: list the connected servers

commands.name: projects
commands.help: list the local projects and the ones on every connected server

commands.name: open-tab
commands.help: open a saved project in a new tab

commands.name: open-window
commands.help: open a saved project in a new window

commands.name: fetch
commands.help: open a server project here

commands.name: sync
commands.help: write edits of a server project back to its server as they happen

commands.name: desktop
commands.help: open this project in the desktop app

commands.name: browser
commands.help: open this project in the browser app

commands.name: prompt
commands.help: ask the assistant; it plans and runs edits

commands.name: llm
commands.help: show or set the assistant's provider config

commands.name: status
commands.help: show the working image (name, size, page, edit position)

commands.name: theme
commands.help: dark, light or auto follows the OS; a name or #hex sets the accent

commands.name: reveal-speed
commands.help: how fast output is revealed (1 = instantly, 0.25 default)

commands.name: clear
commands.help: clear the console

commands.name: help
commands.help: show this list

commands.name: exit
commands.help: close the console (CLI mode: leave it)

commands.name: clioff
commands.help: leave CLI mode

commands.name: ls
commands.help: list the local projects

commands.name: ll
commands.help: list the local projects with their size, colour and date

commands.name: browser-tab
commands.help: open this project in a new browser tab
